rightsClasses.assessorDerivedFacts: PUBLIC_BOUNDED_SUMMARY_ONLY after the existing countywide acquisition/reuse receipt is explicitly linked; raw characteristics, owner data, and mailing data remain excluded
rightsClasses.maintStarPermits: RIGHTS_UNCLEAR and PRIVATE_INTERNAL_ONLY for indexed output until written reuse and bounded redisplay authorization exists
rightsClasses.buildingFootprints: PUBLIC_BOUNDED_SUMMARY_ONLY where the source receipt permits it; raw polygons and full derived geometry are excluded
rightsClasses.derivedCurrentness: PRIVATE_INTERNAL_ONLY when any input is rights-limited; a future bounded warning may be public only after every contributing input is cleared

prohibited: permit or currentness claims not present in the public payload

rules: Include PostalAddress only when a public situs address exists.
Do not use Residence or a residence subtype without current property-intelligence support.
Do not emit generic duplicate FAQPage markup on every parcel page unless each answer is accurate for that parcel.
